identity_model.source_document_id: Preserve source-assigned document identifier verbatim as primary external identity.
identity_model.inventory_number: Secondary physical-object identifier when present; not assumed one-to-one with document identity.
identity_model.museum: Repository context when present; not an identity substitute.
identity_model.joins_and_revised_readings: Do not silently manufacture physical-object equivalence from derivative records.

lineage.dependence: derives from and updates scholarly editions

independence_rule: DĀMOS, its pyaegean snapshot, and project-normalized observations are not independent witnesses merely because they are separate files/services.
admission_rule: A canonical project record must retain source ID, source snapshot identity, applicable license, transformation provenance, and known inventory/museum context. Joins or aliases require explicit authority evidence.
